name: My Own Mod Configurator
author: MickeyDisn
description: In-game configurator to define and register custom elements, structures, items, recipes and processing via JSON config stored in the game. Movable minimizable panel (minimized by default).

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, the mod prunes stale buildings/items, removes its orphaned placed objects and wipes its own storage.

panelMinimized.label: Panel minimized by default
panelMinimized.description: Start the config panel minimized. No item is required to open it.
